records.name: OpenMuse
records.tagline: Opensource, self hostable personal assistant for any harness
records.description: OpenMuse is an open-source, self-hostable personal agent with its own browser, terminal, files, and persistent work. Ask for an outcome, watch it work, review actions, and come back to the result. Compatible with any agent harness.

records.name: Brussle
records.tagline: Improve Jev's accuracy on your data
records.description: Brussle calibrates AI decision from models like Jev about your data, runs it again when a record it read changes, and fits it again when the model changes. A correction is applied only when it beats the model on your held-out outcomes.

records.name: Shrine
records.tagline: A home for your agents
records.description: Shrine lives in your Mac's notch. A glance shows how many Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode sessions are working and which one needs you, so there is no dashboard window to keep open. Each push, pull request and research session earns a piece of pixel art for a small room that fills up as you work. Find the joy in your agents work.

records.name: Polylane Impact Analysis
records.tagline: Catch risky pull requests before they break production
records.description: Catch issues before they break production. Polylane reviews every pull request against your live infrastructure: its config, capacity, dependencies and telemetry. For every pull request, you get a an analysis including all the evidence telling you if the pull request is safe to merge against production. Polylane also proposes missing instrumentation on your branch and keeps watching after deployment.

records.name: Reelbird
records.tagline: Open Source Loom + Screen Studio alternative for Mac
records.description: Reelbird is a free, open-source Mac screen recorder. The share link is on your clipboard when you stop. Later, add auto-zoom, a smooth cursor and captions, then update the same link. Native Swift, no account, your own S3/R2 bucket. Signed and notarized.

records.name: GLM-Legal
records.tagline: Z.ai’s legal AI model for contract review and compliance
records.description: LM-Legal is Z.ai’s legal AI model, built on GLM-5.3-Flash and trained for agentic legal work like contract review, evidence analysis, and compliance research. Z.ai added legal mid-training, then reinforcement learning across tens of thousands of legal task environments. It passes 19.17% of tasks on Harvey’s Legal Agent Benchmark per Vals AI, up from 6.67% for the base model. API access is application-only beta

records.name: Chatway MCP
records.tagline: Let ChatGPT & Claude answer customer support tickets via MCP
records.description: Chatway is a live chat and customer support platform that lets you bring your own AI agent. Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible assistant to manage customer conversations, reply to messages, search contacts, and access your knowledge base. No coding required. Chatway also includes a built-in AI Support Agent, shared inbox, help center, automation, iOS and Android apps, and integrations with WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, and more. Get started for free.

records.name: Ubuntu 26.10 (Stonking Stingray)
records.tagline: GNOME 51, Rust coreutils, and a refreshed Linux desktop
records.description: Ubuntu 26.10 "Stonking Stingray" brings GNOME 51, expanded hardware support, and a complete switch to Rust-based coreutils. App Center unifies Snap and Debian package details and adds graphics driver management. An optional Myna preview offers local speech-to-text. A non-LTS release for developers and Linux enthusiasts who want newer software between long-term releases.

records.name: Apple HomeView
records.tagline: A new way to stay connected, and manage the home
records.description: Apple HomeView is a smart display with Siri AI, Liquid Retina display, high-fidelity audio, FaceTime, smart home controls, built-in privacy, and more.

records.name: Dreamscale Labs
records.tagline: Run the best robot AI models over the cloud
records.description: Dreamscale Labs (YC F26) is building the real-time cloud inference platform for robotics. We serve frontier physical AI models (e.g. VLAs, WAMs) over the cloud with ultra-low latency. Instead of purchasing expensive GPUs, you can run large SOTA models using on-demand cloud inference!

records.name: AI Sandboxes by Buddy
records.tagline: Isolated cloud machines for your AI coding agents
records.description: Buddy Sandboxes give AI coding agents their own isolated Linux machines to build, run, test, and fix apps without touching your local setup. Each Sandbox has a persistent disk, root access, Docker, SSH, and a public URL. Create one per task, branch, or PR, then let your agents manage it through MCP, CLI, SDK, or API.

records.name: Afterparty
records.tagline: Automated actions for meeting deliverables
records.description: Note takers give you a list. Afterparty does the list. Paste a transcript or connect your note taker, and agents draft every email, message, invite and CRM note in the right app, with context from your tools. Nothing goes out until you approve it.

records.name: Audimate
records.tagline: AI assistant that works right in the apps you already use
records.description: Meet Arro, the AI assistant that does the busywork. Arro works right in the apps you already use. Point at something and ask, and it shows you each step on your screen or does the work for you. Show it a task once and it writes a playbook you can read and edit, then repeats it whenever you ask or on a schedule. Ready to use out of the box. No technical setup required. Free for Windows and Mac.

records.name: CinemaLut
records.tagline: Any frame's color, as a LUT for yours.
records.description: CinemaLut turns any reference frame into a LUT for your footage. Drop in a film still, a photo, or a clip. It measures the grade: tone curve, shadow/midtone/highlight tints, saturation per band. Then it builds a matching LUT for your shot. Works with log or Rec.709 from any camera. 60 original looks in 8 collections,cube + Lightroom profiles. First match free.

records.name: Rushilo
records.tagline: Edit video by talking to Claude Code or Codex
records.description: Rushilo is a Mac and Windows video editor that your own AI drives. Connect Claude Code or Codex, select a clip, and say the edit: trim, split, caption, cut filler words, resize, export. Every change lands on a visible timeline you can undo. Screen recording with auto zoom on Mac, on-device Whisper captions, and direct YouTube upload. We ship no AI, so there are no credits: your subscription or keys pay. Files stay on your disk. $99 once, 3 computers.

records.name: Atticus
records.tagline: Hold a key, talk, and your Mac does what you asked
records.description: Hold a shortcut, say what you want, let go. Atticus opens apps, shops for you, fills out forms and answers questions about what's on your screen. It asks before it buys or sends anything. Simple asks run instantly with no AI, and the rest run on your own Claude plan. Free and open source.

records.name: Kerno 1.0
records.tagline: The AI Runtime Backend QA Engineer
records.description: Kerno v1 is our biggest upgrade yet, a complete AI Backend QA Engineer. It maps your codebase, learns how your app works, and gets sharper with every run. It now tests your whole backend, from full user flows and live security checks to background jobs, queues, MCP servers and AWS serverless. Bugs get caught inside your agent's session before you open a PR, then re-checked on every PR in CI.

records.name: siliXon
records.tagline: Turn a plain English idea into a circuit board you can order
records.description: Describe your device in plain English and siliXon takes it all the way to a routed, manufacturable PCB, built for anyone with an idea, not only engineers. In minutes. Rocky, our design agent, asks what it needs to know, then picks real, purchasable components, places them, draws the schematic and routes the copper. Edit in 2D and 3D, or just ask Rocky. Every board must pass engineering checks before it goes to manufacture, and the design files are yours.

records.name: Nostaliga
records.tagline: Rediscover the days behind your favorite songs
records.description: Nostaliga turns your listening history into a personal timeline. Pick any song and see the day around it: your photos, places, runs, check-ins, shows and posts. Plus On This Day across the years. No account, no tracking; your timeline lives on your device.

records.name: withHuman
records.tagline: A open-source human approval layer for AI Agents
records.description: withHuman is an approval layer for AI agents. It intercepts your agents’ tool calls before they run. Rules approve or deny routine calls automatically, and risky ones go to the right person on your team. It works across Claude Code, Codex and agents built with LangGraph, Pydantic AI and more, through an open protocol (AAP). One set of rules for every agent your company runs. Open source, with a hosted version. Use code PRODUCTHUNT for 3 months of Scale free - valid till Friday!

records.name: Daddy Issues
records.tagline: Think ahead. Fight less. A weekly family briefing for dads.
records.description: Daddy Issues uses AI to help dads think ahead before family life turns into last-minute stress. Each week, it connects your kids, calendar, responsibilities and tasks to surface what’s coming up, what you might be missing, and what’s worth handling now. Less reacting, fewer reminders, fewer small fights — and more “I’m already on it.”

records.name: Navige
records.tagline: Cut AI agent costs and control runaway spending
records.description: Navige uses Sufficiency Intelligence to cut AI agent costs while work runs. It sends suitable requests to smaller models, caches repeated reads and trims bulky tool results. If unsure, it keeps your chosen model. Set budgets, catch runaway loops and approve sensitive actions. See costs and savings by job, with estimates clearly labelled. Watchtower is free forever. Preview changes before switching controls on.

records.name: Talanoa
records.tagline: Email that feels like chat
records.description: Talanoa is your first email messenger. It turns messy email threads into clean, chat-like conversations, removing quotes, signatures and clutter along the way. Turn emails into actionable todos, manage your calendar without leaving your inbox, and use private, on-device AI to search, summarize and write. Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud or any IMAP account in one unified inbox. Everything stays on your computer: no cloud sync, no tracking, no one reading your emails.

records.name: Fwrd
records.tagline: Forward iPhone texts to Slack, Discord, or Telegram
records.description: Fwrd routes qualifying iPhone texts to Slack, Discord, or Telegram through a Message automation you create in Apple Shortcuts. The automation runs from your iPhone and sends to destinations you control. No Fwrd account is required. Start with 15 forwards per calendar month free. Setup guide: https://www.fwrdsms.com/guides/automation

records.name: SuperLocalMemory
records.tagline: Agent memory with Laya, Jev + Google Gemma
records.description: The relaunch of SuperLocalMemory, rebuilt from the ground up and backed by four arXiv papers. One local-first memory brain for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, ChatGPT and any MCP or CLI agent. It never bluffs: recall says supported, related or no answer, checked by Laya on your Mac or Jev online. Find pictures and PDFs by describing them, with Google’s EmbeddingGemma 2. Governed, mesh-connected, AGPL-3.0. Built by Qualixar, the AI Reliability Engineering lab behind 10 open-source products.

records.name: SaidTrace
records.tagline: Private voice memos. Your choice of AI.
records.description: Your recordings should stay with you. Your AI should be your choice. Record on your iPhone, Apple Watch, or recorder. SaidTrace brings your audio to your Mac for transcripts and notes. Choose your AI model, ask questions, and trace answers back to the original recording.

records.name: NestJS Observe
records.tagline: Zero-config observability built for NestJS
records.description: Observability built for NestJS by its creator. Add the SDK and a key, and every request shows up as a trace of your own controllers, providers and queries, with errors, jobs, logs and runtime metrics alongside. Free up to 300k events a month.

records.name: Audio Lip Sync Pro for Blender
records.tagline: Generate high-quality facial animations, direct from audio.
records.description: Audio Lip Sync Pro is a tool for animators and modellers to generate high-quality lip-sync animations directly from audio clips. All processing is performed locally, no account, subscription, or network access is (or ever will be) required. Buy once, own for life! Currently, it supports meshes with ARKit blendshapes inside Blender (via the Video Sequencer). Releases for Unity and Maya are coming soon!

records.name: Lleverage
records.tagline: The autonomous back office for the physical economy
records.description: Lleverage runs the back office of manufacturers, wholesalers and distributors with AI agents. They read orders, invoices and purchase orders from email and PDF, check them against the ERP (SAP, Business Central, Exact, NetSuite and more) and post the clean ones. People only handle the exceptions, with approvals and a full audit trail. No migration: the ERP stays the system of record. EU hosted.

records.name: Backdrop
records.tagline: Build AI coworkers for any workflow, any industry
records.description: Create AI coworkers for any workflow. Give them access to the right tools and context, and let them research, create, coordinate, follow up, and get work done. Connect them to Slack, Asana, Google, Hubspot, Meta, TikTok, and 1500+ more apps.

records.name: Basedash Connector gallery
records.tagline: See what you'll build before you connect a data source
records.description: The Basedash Connector gallery gives every data source its own home page. Open HubSpot, or any of 750+ connectors, and you get a one-click Connect, its docs, and four previews on example data — a live dashboard, a question asked in plain language, a Slack alert, and a join with another source. Once it's connected, the same page holds the sync controls: pause it, set the frequency, or sync now. See what you'll build before you connect.

records.name: Actually Asked
records.tagline: A self-improving branded AI FAQ page
records.description: Actually Asked puts a FAQ section on your site, in your fonts and colours, not a chat bubble. Visitors ask their own question or highlight a sentence to ask about it. Answers come only from your pages, and the questions asked most join your FAQ.

records.name: CodeCrab
records.tagline: AI code reviews with deep analysis & multi-tool integrations
records.description: CodeCrab is your local-first AI code review assistant. This version connects seamlessly with GitHub, GitLab, Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Copilot CLI. Drill into every exact change with our new Finding Deep-Dive & Follow-Up feature to inspect, question, and refine AI suggestions without leaving your workflow.

records.tagline: Assess how engineers build with artificial intelligence

You send a candidate a link and they get 55 minutes with Claude Code to implement industry-standard work in a real codebase. Each task is tailor-made to measure how good a candidate is at combining their engineering skills with agents. At the end of the assessment you get a score on four plain questions and a replay of every call they made. Scoring is rule-based, with no LLM judge. $49 for 10 candidates, one-time, lasts a year.

records.name: Superdraft
records.tagline: Automatically identify opportunities to email your customers
records.description: Good email opportunities slip by when you’re busy running a business. Superdraft spots them and turns them into on-brand drafts with copy, images, and layout. Edit, export HTML, and send through your existing email platform.

It never receives the image, reads screen text or uploads anything. A free compatibility test runs first, ten watch captures are included, then Lifetime Pro is a one-time purchase. Lightweight deployment that works with your existing security stack.

records.name: SerpScope Technical SEO Inspector

records.name: the Snowy Beauty of Himachal Pradesh

records.name: HanCam

records.description: HanCam reads printed Chinese through your iPhone or iPad camera and shows three lines at once: the characters, the pinyin with tone marks, and the meaning in your phone's language. records.name: TokenSave

records.description: TokenSave is a free online converter that turns PDFs (with OCR for scanned pages), Word documents, images and audio files (WhatsApp OPUS/OGG, MP3, M4A, WAV) into clean, structured Markdown text ready to paste into ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude. records.name: DSCR Calculator

records.name: Google Review AI

records.description: Google Review AI helps businesses manage their Google reputation from one place. Sync Google Business Profile reviews, generate on-brand AI replies, and publish responses faster. records.name: Doubtclip

records.name: CRYPTO JONES DEX
records.tagline: Exchange Platform
records.description: Crypto Jones DEX is a versatile exchange platform that caters to both retail and institutional investors, enabling seamless trading of crypto assets and real-world assets across multiple EVM-compatible networks. It offers a wide range of features, including a gasless swap option, making transactions more cost-effective and user-friendly for traders of all levels.

records.name: formrize.com
records.tagline: Forms that actually get you booked
records.description: Build sleek, conversion-focused forms and booking flows without giving away your data or paying monthly SaaS fees. Formrize keeps everything strictly inside your local browser with zero external storage. Enjoy advanced features like dynamic answer piping, conditional logic, AI generation, and calendar booking. Export unlimited responses straight to CSV or push them directly to your own webhooks.

records.name: BA II Plus Calculator
records.tagline: The complete TI BA II Plus, in your browser
records.description: Free online BA II Plus calculator (BA 2 Plus): a working TI BA II Plus emulator and simulator with TVM, NPV, IRR, bond, amortization and statistics. No download.

records.name: Nodebook
records.tagline: PDF reader with mind maps, flashcards & OCR
records.description: Nodebook combines a document reader with an infinite mind map. Highlight a passage in a PDF, EPUB, video, audio file or web page, and it appears on your canvas as a node, linked to the exact place it came from. The reader and annotations are free; creating and editing maps requires Plus. Max adds sync, collaboration and version history.

records.name: MapGuesser.gg
records.tagline: Daily geography game. Guess 5 locations on the globe.
records.description: MapGuesser is a free daily geography game. Guess 5 locations on a satellite map, score up to 1000 points, and build your streak. Battle your friends in duel mode, or play with a group in party mode. Learn about the world, and track improvements in your geography skills!

records.name: GoalsArea
records.tagline: Goals and Highlights from every major football league
records.description: GoalsArea is the ultimate destination for football fans who want to relive the action, instantly. Whether you missed the live match or just want to see that stunning strike one more time, we bring you high-quality video highlights from the Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Champions League, Europa League and beyond. Missed the game? No problem. Catch up instantly on GoalsArea.

records.name: Jotease
records.tagline: Your best LinkedIn content is already in your meetings.

records.name: Can I Get Business Funding
records.tagline: Free 5-question quiz showing which business funding fits you
records.description: A free online questionnaire for small business owners, including startups, new businesses, owners turned down by a bank, and owners with less-than-perfect credit. Answer five questions and see which types of business funding are worth looking into, explained in plain language. No credit pull, not a loan application.

records.name: LumiFind 1.6 is Out

records.description: We're rolling out LumiFind 1.6, a release focused on speed, transparency, and reliability. Please download it from here: https://lumifind.midilli.tech/download

records.name: Flow — Budget & Expense Tracker

records.description: Meet Flow — your all-in-one personal finance tracker for iPhone, iPad & Apple Watch. 💳 Expense & income tracking in one calm timeline 🔄 Subscription manager — never pay for a forgotten free trial again 🎯 Smart budgeting & runway planning 📈 Stock & fund portfolio with live quotes ☁️ Privacy-first: local storage + iCloud sync Free to start. Flow Pro unlocks unlimited accounts/budgets, investments & subscriptions pages, Apple Watch, and automatic market data refresh.

records.name: okPDF
records.tagline: 20 free PDF tools. Your files stay on your device.
records.description: Merge, split, organize, edit and sign PDFs in your browser for free, without an account. Document contents stay on your device. okPDF includes 20 tools, a 14-language interface and OCR in 12 languages, with clear file and feature limits.

records.name: Steady Tally
records.tagline: Every day becomes a dot.
records.description: Steady Tally is an iPhone habit and medication tracker. One tap logs it. Every day becomes a dot. Over weeks, the dots show you what is working.

records.name: Map AI
records.tagline: US neighborhood data, trade areas and sales forecasts
records.description: Map AI is an interactive map of the United States built for location decisions. It shows over 100 indicators — income, housing, schools, crime, health, commute, amenities and competitors — down to one-mile cells. Users build drive-time trade areas, compare two addresses side by side, and forecast revenue for a site.

records.name: StreetSiege — Run, Ride & Conquer City
records.tagline: Turn your runs and rides into a game of territory
records.description: StreetSiege turns your city into a game board: close a loop on foot and the ground inside is yours — until someone takes it. Get it on Google Play and the App Store. Free.

records.name: ChinaWander: AI Trip Planner for China
records.tagline: AI trip plans for China — verified, timed, and taxi-ready
records.description: Day-by-day China itineraries built to survive the actual trip: timed stops, real ticket prices and opening hours, a Chinese address card for every stop, one-tap Amap directions, and warnings for reservations you must book ahead. Read a complete real sample first — from $19, one-time, no subscription.

records.name: KindTake: Leadership Simulator
records.tagline: Rehearse difficult conversations and build confidence.
records.description: KindTake is a voice-first leadership flight simulator designed to help managers practice workplace conversations before having them in real life. Instead of passively reading management articles or static checklist templates, leaders enter real-time, simulated 1-on-1s with dynamic personas that push back, make excuses, or react defensively. It provides a private, zero-risk sandbox to build conversational muscle memory and lead with clarity.

records.name: Grasp for Mac & Chrome
records.tagline: Parallel translation that keeps the original in view
records.description: Read web pages with the original and translation together, paragraph by paragraph. When a word is still unclear, Grasp explains it in that sentence. Ask follow-ups and save terms with their context. The companion Mac app brings contextual lookup to other apps.

records.name: Nes Design
records.tagline: Astro templates, sections and components for your AI agent
records.description: Finished Astro templates, sections and components your AI agent installs for you. 18 templates, 169 sections, 112 components and 181 code gradients. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or ChatGPT pull the real source, your theme tokens and design rules over MCP straight into your Astro project. Templates build to static files you host on Cloudflare, Vercel or Netlify. Free plan included.

records.name: The Visionary Platform
records.tagline: Training, meal plans and courses built around your week
records.description: One wellness app instead of three. Visionary builds personalised training (8 levels), meal plans with a photo food scanner, and expert-led courses around the days you pick and the kit you have. If your week changes, move a workout or swap a meal. Cycle tracking, a sleep log and Vic, an AI coach, are included. Health content is reviewed by a practitioner with 27+ years in practice. Runs in any browser; 7-day free trial, then from $14.99/month.

records.name: TipTools
records.tagline: 100+ free developer utilities running 100% in your browser
records.description: Hi hunters! Every day,tech professionals need quick tasks done. But most existing tools are slow and send your sensitive inputs to unknown servers. That's why I built *TipTools*: *Privacy-First:* 100% of the tools run directly on your browser. Zero server processing *Lightning Fast:* Fully static architecture *100+ Practical Tools:* Everything in one single, clean, and distraction-free interface. *100% Free & No Registration:* Take it for a spin and let me know what tools you'd love to see next!

records.name: ELM327 OBD-II
records.tagline: Node.js & TypeScript library for ELM327 OBD2 adapters
records.description: A robust, modern Node.js and TypeScript library designed to seamlessly interface with ELM327 OBD2 vehicle diagnostic adapters across USB, Bluetooth, and WiFi connections. Whether you're building custom automotive dashboards, vehicle telemetry systems, or diagnostic tools, elm327 provides a clean, reliable, and type-safe abstraction layer to query vehicle data, read sensors, and clear diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) with ease.

records.name: GoodsTracker
records.tagline: From spreadsheet chaos to 100% warehouse control.
records.description: GoodsTracker is the all-in-one inbound logistics platform for warehouse teams. Replace clipboards and Excel sheets with real-time audio/visual alerts, Dock-to-Stock SLA tracking, automated damage claim PDFs, and an internal PO lookup portal.

records.name: VeloxaHost
records.tagline: Web hosting and hourly VPS from $5, with an AI site builder
records.description: VeloxaHost puts managed web hosting and cloud servers on one account. Host 3 to 100 sites on NVMe plans from $9.99/month, or launch a VPS from $5/month, billed by the hour and capped at the monthly price. Every plan includes a browser terminal, file manager, Git deploys, one-click WordPress, snapshots, weekly backups and a full REST API. 14-day free trial, no card needed. Veloxa Build, our AI site and app builder, runs on the same account.

records.name: Audimate
records.tagline: AI assistant that works right in the apps you already use
records.description: Meet Arro, the AI assistant that does the busywork. Arro works right in the apps you already use. Point at something and ask, and it shows you each step on your screen or does the work for you. Show it a task once and it writes a playbook you can read and edit, then repeats it whenever you ask or on a schedule. Ready to use out of the box. No technical setup required. Free for Windows and Mac.

records.name: Billvy
records.tagline: Simple GST invoicing for Indian shop owners & businesses
records.description: Billvy is simple GST invoicing software for Indian businesses — shop owners, caterers, and contractors. Create GST-compliant invoices, track payments, and manage your business from your phone.

records.name: Section Store
records.tagline: Shopify cart drawer, bundles & 700+ theme sections
records.description: Add a high-converting cart drawer, product bundles and quantity breaks, plus 700+ ready-made theme sections, to your Shopify store in one click. Native theme editor, no code. Now with MCP server access, so AI assistants can connect to and work with the app directly.

records.name: Lingard
records.tagline: Learn languages by reading, remember words in context
records.description: Lingard turns books, news and your own texts into personal language practice. Read or listen, then tap a word to explore its meaning in context, word forms, synonyms and common word combinations with AI. Save the meanings you need and practise them through listening, speaking, spelling and spaced repetition. Follow topics you care about while your reading, vocabulary and progress stay in sync across iOS, Android, Mac and the web.

records.name: CinemaLut
records.tagline: Any frame's color, as a LUT for yours.
records.description: CinemaLut turns any reference frame into a LUT for your footage. Drop in a film still, a photo, or a clip. It measures the grade: tone curve, shadow/midtone/highlight tints, saturation per band. Then it builds a matching LUT for your shot. Works with log or Rec.709 from any camera. 60 original looks in 8 collections,cube + Lightroom profiles. First match free.

records.name: Rushilo
records.tagline: Edit video by talking to Claude Code or Codex
records.description: Rushilo is a Mac and Windows video editor that your own AI drives. Connect Claude Code or Codex, select a clip, and say the edit: trim, split, caption, cut filler words, resize, export. Every change lands on a visible timeline you can undo. Screen recording with auto zoom on Mac, on-device Whisper captions, and direct YouTube upload. We ship no AI, so there are no credits: your subscription or keys pay. Files stay on your disk. $99 once, 3 computers.

records.name: Atticus
records.tagline: Hold a key, talk, and your Mac does what you asked
records.description: Hold a shortcut, say what you want, let go. Atticus opens apps, shops for you, fills out forms and answers questions about what's on your screen. It asks before it buys or sends anything. Simple asks run instantly with no AI, and the rest run on your own Claude plan. Free and open source.

records.name: Kerno 1.0
records.tagline: The AI Runtime Backend QA Engineer
records.description: Kerno v1 is our biggest upgrade yet, a complete AI Backend QA Engineer. It maps your codebase, learns how your app works, and gets sharper with every run. It now tests your whole backend, from full user flows and live security checks to background jobs, queues, MCP servers and AWS serverless. Bugs get caught inside your agent's session before you open a PR, then re-checked on every PR in CI.

records.name: siliXon
records.tagline: Turn a plain English idea into a circuit board you can order
records.description: Describe your device in plain English and siliXon takes it all the way to a routed, manufacturable PCB, built for anyone with an idea, not only engineers. In minutes. Rocky, our design agent, asks what it needs to know, then picks real, purchasable components, places them, draws the schematic and routes the copper. Edit in 2D and 3D, or just ask Rocky. Every board must pass engineering checks before it goes to manufacture, and the design files are yours.

records.name: Nostaliga
records.tagline: Rediscover the days behind your favorite songs
records.description: Nostaliga turns your listening history into a personal timeline. Pick any song and see the day around it: your photos, places, runs, check-ins, shows and posts. Plus On This Day across the years. No account, no tracking; your timeline lives on your device.

records.name: GrowKitt
records.tagline: 34 marketing tools. One payment. No subscription.
records.description: GrowKitt is a desktop app with 34 marketing tools for small businesses and freelancers: AI visibility (what ChatGPT, Gemini & Perplexity say about you), SEO audits, keyword research, reviews, email campaigns, a leads CRM and one-click client report PDFs. Runs locally — your data stays on your machine. Pay once ($149), own it forever. Free 7-day trial.

records.name: withHuman
records.tagline: A open-source human approval layer for AI Agents
records.description: withHuman is an approval layer for AI agents. It intercepts your agents’ tool calls before they run. Rules approve or deny routine calls automatically, and risky ones go to the right person on your team. It works across Claude Code, Codex and agents built with LangGraph, Pydantic AI and more, through an open protocol (AAP). One set of rules for every agent your company runs. Open source, with a hosted version. Use code PRODUCTHUNT for 3 months of Scale free - valid till Friday!

records.name: Daddy Issues
records.tagline: Think ahead. Fight less. A weekly family briefing for dads.
records.description: Daddy Issues uses AI to help dads think ahead before family life turns into last-minute stress. Each week, it connects your kids, calendar, responsibilities and tasks to surface what’s coming up, what you might be missing, and what’s worth handling now. Less reacting, fewer reminders, fewer small fights — and more “I’m already on it.”

records.name: Nebula KB
records.tagline: AI knowledge base that writes your notes while you listen
records.description: Nebula KB is a Windows knowledge base with AI built in. Record a lecture or a meeting and get a live transcript turned into structured notes. Import a YouTube video, PDF or web page. Then review with AI-generated flashcards and spaced repetition, share read-only with friends, and export to PDF or Markdown. Free during the beta.

records.name: WHAT THE GENRE!?
records.tagline: The most accurate music subgenre database online
records.description: Look up any track and get its real subgenre: big beat, not house. Full on, not trance. Liquid funk, not just drum and bass. Think it's wrong? Vote it right, with one line on why. Free, no sign-up needed to vote.

records.name: Navige
records.tagline: Cut AI agent costs and control runaway spending
records.description: Navige uses Sufficiency Intelligence to cut AI agent costs while work runs. It sends suitable requests to smaller models, caches repeated reads and trims bulky tool results. Preview changes before switching controls on.

records.name: Talanoa
records.tagline: Email that feels like chat
records.description: Talanoa is your first email messenger. It turns messy email threads into clean, chat-like conversations, removing quotes, signatures and clutter along the way. Turn emails into actionable todos, manage your calendar without leaving your inbox, and use private, on-device AI to search, summarize and write. Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud or any IMAP account in one unified inbox. Everything stays on your computer: no cloud sync, no tracking, no one reading your emails.

records.name: Shellog: Pilates & Posture
records.tagline: Stretching, Pilates, Posture, Flexbility,Stretech

In your shared pond, the weekly leaderboard counts the days you showed up, not how flexible you are. Weekly check-ins score your posture from two photos, so you can see the change.

records.name: DOT.in
records.tagline: Back To The Future
records.description: Currently in India, thanks to recent student protests, there’s been a concerted effort, almost with the same gusto with which China is building sprinting robots, for the authorities to understand this strange non-conformist beast called Gen Z.

records.name: StatementXL

No persistent file history on our site. Review exports against the original statement.

records.tagline: keyboard testing tool

What makes it different: match the test to your board with Windows or Mac, ANSI or ISO, and full-size, TKL, 75%, or 60% layouts, and hold multiple keys to test ghosting. It runs in your browser and key presses are never sent anywhere.

records.name: Lunatic Fling
records.tagline: Lunatic Fringe-inspired space combat with a daily challenge
records.description: Lunatic Fling is Newtonian space combat for iPhone, iPad and Mac. No friction, a relativistic speed limit, a ship that falls apart one part at a time, black holes to slingshot around, and a new sector every day that the whole world flies. Free to play. No ads, no tracking.

records.name: ARG architect
records.tagline: A full website audit in one click, free and private
records.description: ARG Architect is a free browser extension that audits any public page in one click. records.name: BodhX AI

records.name: Chia Hóa Đơn

In Vietnamese and English.

records.description: Fwrd routes qualifying iPhone texts to Slack, Discord, or Telegram through a Message automation you create in Apple Shortcuts. records.name: Digitomics AI
records.tagline: FinOps Autopilot for AI, Cloud & Beyond
records.description: Digitomics uses AI to optimise technology spending across cloud, AI, SaaS, and on-premises systems. Connect: Integrate data through connected sources or manual uploads. Analyze: Explore costs, investigate drivers with Orbit, and track budgets. Optimize: Identify efficiencies, SaaS usage gaps, and savings. records.name: SaidTrace

records.name: Audio Lip Sync Pro for Blender

records.name: Lleverage

records.name: Backdrop

records.name: Basedash Connector gallery

records.name: Actually Asked

records.name: CodeCrab
records.tagline: AI code reviews with deep analysis & multi-tool integrations
records.description: CodeCrab is your local-first AI code review assistant. This version connects seamlessly with GitHub, GitLab, Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Copilot CLI. records.name: CmdRound

records.description: CmdRound is an assessment platform for hiring managers. records.name: Superdraft
records.tagline: Automatically identify opportunities to email your customers
records.description: Good email opportunities slip by when you’re busy running a business. Superdraft spots them and turns them into on-brand drafts with copy, images, and layout. Edit, export HTML, and send through your existing email platform.

records.name: Oktomer
records.tagline: Live chat, email and WhatsApp help desk at one fixed price
records.description: One fixed price for your whole support team. Seats and conversations are unlimited on every plan, so your busiest week costs the same as a quiet one. Oktomer brings the live chat on your site or Shopify store, your support email and WhatsApp into one inbox. Urgent messages go on top, with the reason why. Reply from your computer or your phone. Start free, or get AI help starting at $49/month: AI sorts and tags every message and nudges you before a customer waits too long.

records.name: Kalkandam
records.tagline: 700 Malayalam fonts. Preview, convert, download.
records.description: Type once and see your text in 700 Malayalam fonts, from free Unicode faces like Manjari and Nupuram to the classic ML-TT and FML fonts used in DTP. Legacy fonts just work: text is converted to each font's encoding automatically. Includes a Unicode ⇄ ML / FML converter for PageMaker and Photoshop, Manglish typing for phones without a Malayalam keyboard, and PNG export you can share straight to WhatsApp. Free, open source, and made for phones., Manglish typing and PNG export.

records.name: Lampole
records.tagline: Everyone shoots. Nobody posts. One slideshow at 9 AM.
records.description: Lampole turns little moments into something special. Shoot whatever you want, whenever you want with your people. At 9 AM the next morning, everyone's photos and 6-sec videos automatically become one slideshow with a soundtrack. No feed — you can't see each other's shots, react, or comment yet. At 9 AM, look back on everyone's shots. React to and comment on the day, not individual shots. Even a blurry selfie or an ordinary lunch can feel surprisingly moving when everyone's shots come together.

records.name: BellRun
records.tagline: Get AI to make better day trades on real-time stock data
records.description: Talk an AI chute boss into better day trades on real-time stock data, and keep the crowd buying tickets.
